# Time.is

> Time.is provides exact current time and timezone information for 7 million global locations in 58 languages, with sunrise/sunset data and timezone conversion tools.

Time.is is a comprehensive world clock service offering real-time time displays, timezone converters, and daylight saving time information for cities worldwide. The platform leverages IANA timezone data to deliver accurate time information across all time zones.

## Key Topics

- Current time
- World clock
- Time zones
- Timezone converter
- UTC
- Daylight saving time
- Sunrise/sunset
- Exact time
- Time comparison
- IANA timezone database
- Time zone info
- Global locations
- DST handling
- Time display
- Timezone conversion
